categories.main_business_segments: Daegu Department Store Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the department store business, focusing on retail sales of clothing and miscellaneous goods. It also engages in brand business featuring premium knitwear and luxury tailoring brands, and operates a chain business with 102 franchise stores in the Daegu and Gyeongbuk regions. Its major subsidiary, Daebak Outlet Co., Ltd., is involved in real estate leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company does not engage in manufacturing or technology development but focuses on retail operations, brand management, and real estate leasing. Its core methods include merchandising (MD) strategies, store modernization, and differentiated customer service to enhance retail competitiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are final consumers purchasing apparel, accessories, and other goods at department stores and franchise outlets. The company also serves corporate clients through special orders. The real estate leasing subsidiary targets commercial tenants in the Daegu region.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in South Korea, primarily in Daegu metropolitan area and the Gyeongbuk region. The company’s retail and real estate activities are regionally focused without international operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Daegu Department Store operates downstream in the retail supply chain, acting as a retailer and brand manager. It sources products from manufacturers and suppliers and sells directly to consumers. The subsidiary operates in real estate leasing, providing commercial space to tenants.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes customer-centric service, store modernization, and merchandising enhancement to maintain competitiveness amid a mature market. It is preparing to enter real estate consulting, investment management, and development to diversify revenue streams. No formal R&D activities are reported.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales in department stores and franchise outlets, supplemented by rental income from leased properties. The company also earns from brand business sales and online shopping mall partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Daegu Department Store competes with large-scale department stores and new retail formats such as online malls, discount stores, and outlets. It holds a regional position with strong local brand recognition and faces intensified competition from nationwide chains and emerging retail channels.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company has total assets of approximately 467 billion KRW and total liabilities of 270 billion KRW, with equity of 197 billion KRW. Revenue declined by about 10.9% year-over-year to 67.6 billion KRW, with operating losses narrowing slightly but net losses worsening due to increased financial costs. The company is in a mature, low-growth phase with efforts to stabilize finances through asset sales and cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes customer-first management, differentiated merchandising strategies tailored to store characteristics, and enhanced customer service to provide a superior shopping experience. It leverages its long-standing regional presence and brand partnerships to offer unique premium products and lifestyle services, aiming to maintain loyalty in a competitive retail environment.
